description: The fleet's default arming policy. Each organisation's agent-fabric-settings repository (projects/registry.json settings_repos) holds repos/<repo>.json, which overrides this per repository: objects merge recursively, scalars replace. The shape is identities/schemas/arming.schema.json. Below the minimum of work commits a PR is armed only on the owner's word; the 8 and 16 are the minimum and the size above which the gate advises splitting; boundary_min is the security boundary's own minimum, which no repository lowers. reviews lists the engines (claude, codex) whose review of the current head a PR needs, boundary_reviews the engines a security-boundary change needs as well (agent-fabric ADR-053 rule 6); a list replaces.
